conflict_rule: the higher known band is used and severity_conflict is recorded
family_band_rule: highest known band among active members; unknown only when no active member has a known band; has_unknown_member recorded; withdrawn members never contribute
notes: Ranking policy only. The placement of the unknown band between medium and low is a ranking-policy choice, not a severity estimate; it is part of the digest and revisable by E0 before freeze. No ranker is claimed to be better than another.
